spans.s: गो-शकृत् n. cowdung.
गो-शाल n. a cowstall.
गो-शाला f. a cowstall.
गो-षड्गव n. three pairs of kine.
गो-ष्ठ (I) m.n. 1. a cowhouse, a stable; 2. a station of cowherds.
गो-ष्ठ (II) m. an assembly, a meeting.
गो-ष्ठ˚श्व m. 1. a dog in a cowpen which barks at every one; 2. a person who stays home and slanders his neighbours.
गोष्ठपंडित a. learned in a cowpen, i.e. a vain boaster.

गो-ष्ठि, -ष्ठी f. 1. an assembly, a meeting; 2. conversation, cbat, गोष्ठीसुखमनुभवंस्तिष्ठति Hit.i.; 3. relatives requiring maintenance, विषं गोष्ठी दर्र्द्रस्य Cāṇakya.; 4. a multitude; 5. a kind of dramatic composition in one act.

गो-ष्ठि, -ष्ठी f. 1. an assembly, a meeting; 2. conversation, cbat, गोष्ठीसुखमनुभवंस्तिष्ठति Hit.i.; 3. relatives requiring maintenance, विषं गोष्ठी दर्र्द्रस्य Cāṇakya.; 4. a multitude; 5. a kind of dramatic composition in one act.
गो-ष्ठी˚पति m. the chief of an assembly, a president.

गोष्पद n. 1. a cow’s foot; 2. the impression of a cows foot; 3. a quantity of water sufficient to fill such an impression, a small puddle; 4. a measure as much as a cows’s foot-step will hold; 5. a spot frequented by kine.
गो-संख्य m. a cowherd.
गो-सदृक्ष m. a species of ox (गवय).
गो-सर्ग m. the time at which cows are usually let loose, day-break. See गोविसर्ग.
गो-सूत्रिका f. a rope fastened at both ends having separate halters for each ox or cow.
गो-स्तन m. 1. the udder of a cow; 2. a cluster of blossoms, a nosegay; 3. a pearl-necklace of four strings.
गो-स्तना, -स्तनी f. a bunch of grapes.
गो-स्तना, -स्तनी f. a bunch of grapes.
गो-स्थान n. a cowpen.
गो-स्वामिन् m. 1. an owner of cows; 2. a religious mendicant; 3. an honorary title affixed to proper names, (e.g. वोपदेवगोस्वामिन्).
गोष्ट् vi. 1Ā (pres. गोष्टते) To assemble, to collect, to heap together.
